Architecture Decision Record template

Note: 

For retrospective ADRs, do not infer historical motivations or alternatives from the current code. Record only rationale supported by issues, PRs, documentation, commits, or other contemporaneous evidence.

A retrospective ADR records the current architectural decision and the
historical evidence available for it; it does not imply the ADR existed when
the decision was originally made.

---

# ADR-NNNN: <decision>

Status: Proposed | Accepted | Superseded
Date: YYYY-MM-DD
Retrospective: yes/no

## Context

What problem or architectural pressure caused this decision?

## Decision

What are we committing to?

## Consequences

What becomes easier/harder because of this?

## Alternatives

Only include alternatives that are actually known from issues, PRs,
existing docs, or discussion.

## References

Relevant issues, PRs, specs, or architecture docs.
